name: Whitman College, Princeton University

dates.note: Wikipedia (Porphyrios): 'In 2002, Princeton University commissioned him to design a residential college (Whitman College) in the Collegiate Gothic style, which was completed in 2007'; dedicated 26-27 September 2007 (Princeton Alumni); project cost $136 million.

refs.title: Whitman College, Princeton University - Wikipedia
refs.note: 'designed by the architect Demetri Porphyrios, the winner of the 2004 Driehaus Prize. Whitman College was completed in the fall of 2007'.

refs.title: Princeton's Whitman College marks revival of traditional architecture (Princeton University, 24 Sep 2007)
refs.note: Owner. 'completed with stone wall masonry, slate roofs, and copper and wood detailing'.

refs.title: Porphyrios celebrates revival of traditional architecture with design of Whitman College - 9/24/2007 - Princeton Weekly Bulletin
refs.note: Porphyrios: 'Whitman College is important for the revival of traditional architecture in the States' and 'some built in random fieldstone, others in coursed Indiana cut-stone'.

refs.title: Whitman College dedicated, September 26-27, 2007 | Princeton Alumni

note: Written 4 Sep 2026. Collegiate Gothic in idiom, by a New Classical architect: it is on the node for the method (load-bearing stone, a family of buildings in one language) and not for the orders, and the exemplar note says so.
